notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Caged Sun to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat step 3.
As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.
